Everyone has a different trick to set up his motor home or caravan on uneven camping grounds or on the way on pitches horizontally. 
Professionals use WomoSet for this - since 2009 ! 

A correct position of the vehicle is important - otherwise the water in the shower cabin won't run off properly, the stove doesn't work properly, you sleep uncomfortably etc.

iWoMoSet is the first IPhone/iPod touch application that allows you to align the vehicle correctly within seconds. At the touch of a button WomoSet shows you the height of each wheel to be balanced. If you want also with voice announcement on your iPhone or on your Apple Watch.

There is no easier and faster way! A MUST for every motor home fan!

You can find detailed instructions for aligning your motorhome here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xR8wS4ZCLJY&t=575s

summary.label:
Calculate times of sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset and more for your location at any given date.

The following data is calculated:

- Sunrise 
- Solar noon
- Sunset
- Day length
- Equation of time
- Declination
- Civil twilight (Dawn/Dusk)
- Nautical twilight (Dawn/Dusk)
- Astronomical twilight (Dawn/Dusk)
- Azimuth at sunrise and sunset
- Altitude during solar noon
- Sun track
- Date and time of Seasons (Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter)
- Solstice and Equinox dates
- Date and time of next solar eclipse

- Moonrise
- Moon transit
- Moonset
- Moon phase
- Distance
- Declination
- Date and time of next new moon
- Date and time of next full moon
- Azimuth at moonrise and moonset
- Altitude during moon transit
- Moon track
- Date and time of next lunar eclipse

Some information for the current day can also be viewed in the notification center. 

To specify the location of interest either get the position from the built-in GPS or Wifi receiver or select a city from a database with over 400,000 cities in over 200 countries.
